mapper.sql: id, task_id, seq, stage, status, attempt_count, message_args, error_code, started_at, finished_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_step (task_id, seq, stage, status, attempt_count) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{seq}, #{stage}, 'PENDING', 0)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM task_step WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY seq
mapper.update: UPDATE task_step SET status = 'RUNNING', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, started_at = COALESCE(started_at, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)), finished_at = NULL, error_code = NULL, message_args = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING','FAILED')
UPDATE task_step SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', message_args = #{messageArgs}, error_code = NULL, finished_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE task_step SET status = 'FAILED', error_code = #{errorCode}, message_args = NULL, finished_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE task_step SET status = 'SKIPPED', error_code = NULL, message_args = NULL WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND seq > #{seq} AND status = 'PENDING'
